instructions.name: annotate_payment
docs: Attaches a receipt to a payment entry of pagaré `draw_index`: appends a Recibo entry over
`receipt_hash`, referencing entry `entry_count` of the pagaré's chain. The holder or the
attestor signs; the repair path when a payer's hash was zero or wrong.

accounts.name: annotator
docs: The holder (the admin while the asset is in the pool) or the attestor.

instructions.name: cancel_line
docs: Clears an approved commitment nobody drew. Admin only; refused once anything was drawn.

instructions.name: cancel_pagare
docs: Marks pagaré `draw_index` paid against the receipt `receipt_hash`, writes the Terminacion
entry and burns its asset; the record is kept. The holder (the admin while the asset is in
the pool) or the procurador of record signs, with the attestor; refused until the line's
principal repaid covers the pagaré, and in collection or after a write-off. Never paused.

accounts.name: holder
docs: Who extinguishes the title: the holder (the admin while the asset is in the pool) or the
procurador of record (`Pagare::procurador`, with a procuración in force); checked in the
handler (`NotHolder`).

accounts.name: attestor
docs: Attests the receipt behind `receipt_hash` and that the asset's log was archived. Optional
for the backstop: left out, the holder cancels alone only after a recorded request's
deadline, with the requested receipt (`AttestorRequired` otherwise).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Receives the asset's rent from the Core program. Any signer.

accounts.name: pagare
docs: The sidecar of pagaré `draw_index` of the line; it is written, never closed.

accounts.name: asset
docs: The Core asset the sidecar names; burnt by the Core program.

accounts.name: collection
docs: The series' collection the asset belongs to.

accounts.name: procurador_authority
docs: The program address the burn delegate was approved to, `["procurador", pagare, holder]`:
required on the procurador's branch, where the program signs for it; left out on the
owner's.

instructions.name: court_annotation
docs: Records a court's act on pagaré `draw_index`: `kind` is AnotacionJudicial (6: embargo,
suspension, cancellation) or ConstanciaJudicial (7, LGTOC 28), over the court document's
hash. The holder and the attestor sign; nothing moves.

accounts.name: holder
docs: The pagaré's holder: the admin while the asset is in the pool.

accounts.name: attestor
docs: Attests the court document behind `document_hash`.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposits `assets` for shares at the current NAV, at least `min_shares_out`; the first
deposit locks `DEAD_SHARES`. Refused while paused.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Read for its decimals (`transfer_checked`).

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The asset's token program.

accounts.name: share_token_program
docs: The share mint's token program.

instructions.name: draw
docs: Draws a tranche of `amount` to the borrower against the signed pagaré `document_hash` and
mints the pagaré asset with its record. The borrower, the attestor and the rent payer
sign; refused while paused, once the draw window has closed, or above what is available.

accounts.name: attestor
docs: Attests that the pagaré behind `document_hash` was signed by the borrower and is conserved.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Read for its decimals (`transfer_checked`).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the pagaré asset and its sidecar. Any signer.

accounts.name: asset
docs: The Core asset that is the pagaré, created by the Core program here. The client passes
the bump, so the constraint runs one `create_program_address` and the compute of a draw
does not depend on the line's key.

accounts.name: pagare
docs: The pagaré's record, created by the handler (Anchor's `init` would search for the bump).

accounts.name: collection
docs: The series' collection the pool controls (validated at `init_pool`).

instructions.name: endorse_pagare
docs: Endorses pagaré `draw_index` en procuración to `to` (LGTOC 35): appends the entry and lends
the power to extinguish it to a program-signed delegate. The admin (the pool is the owner)
and the attestor sign; in this version `kind` must be `KIND_PROCURACION`.

accounts.name: holder
docs: The pagaré's holder: the admin while the asset is in the pool.

accounts.name: attestor
docs: Attests the signed endoso behind `endoso_hash` and the endorsee's verification (v1 gate).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent the Core plugin may need. Any signer.

instructions.name: init_pool
docs: Creates the pool, its vault and its dead-shares account around `asset_mint` and the
admin's share mint; fixes the grace period, the line cap (`1..=10_000` bps of the NAV)
and the attestor for the life of the pool, and the collection period (at least 30 days).
The admin signs; refused with the admin as attestor.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Classic SPL Token or Token-2022; `token_program` must be the mint's own program.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: The share mint, created by the admin beforehand and validated here: mint authority = this
pool's PDA, supply 0, the asset's decimals, and no extension that takes or hides value.
`DefaultAccountState = Frozen` makes the shares permissioned.

accounts.name: vault
docs: A PDA token account, so nobody can pre-create it and block the pool.

accounts.name: dead_shares
docs: Holds the dead shares of the first deposit; nothing ever moves them. On a permissioned
share mint it is born frozen and must be thawed by the mint's freeze authority before the
first deposit (in this transaction or a later one).

accounts.name: collection
docs: The series' Metaplex Core collection, created by the admin beforehand with the pool PDA as
update authority.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The token program of `asset_mint` (classic SPL Token or Token-2022).

accounts.name: share_token_program
docs: The token program of `share_mint` (Token-2022 in production, under Token ACL).

instructions.name: mark_in_collection
docs: Moves a scheduled line to collection once `max_missed` installments are missed and the
grace period of the last of them has run. Anyone may call it, also while paused.

instructions.name: open_line
docs: Approves line `line_id` (the next): a commitment of `principal` at an annual `rate_bps`,
repaid at `term_end` or on the `schedule`'s calendar. The admin, the borrower, the attestor
and the named sponsor sign; refused while paused, with the admin as borrower, or above the
line cap. Moves no money.

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: The sponsor named in the arguments; required (and signing) when one is named.

accounts.name: attestor
docs: Attests that the signed agreement behind `agreement_hash` exists and matches the arguments.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Read for the NAV the concentration cap is measured against.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: Burns `shares` for assets at the current NAV, at least `min_assets_out`, up to the vault's
liquidity. Refused while paused.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Read for its decimals (`transfer_checked`).

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The asset's token program.

accounts.name: share_token_program
docs: The share mint's token program.

instructions.name: repay
docs: Repays up to `amount` of a drawn line: late interest (which `amount` must cover), then
interest, then principal, and never more than is due. Anyone may pay. A full repayment
closes the line and forfeits the undrawn remainder.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone may repay: the borrower, a sponsor paying the interest, or a third party.

accounts.name: asset_mint
docs: Read for its decimals (`transfer_checked`).

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: Read for the share supply (`NavUpdated` and the invariant check).

instructions.name: request_cancellation
docs: Records the holder's request to cancel pagaré `draw_index` against the receipt
`receipt_hash`, the backstop on the attestor: the same checks as the cancellation itself,
one request at a time; after the pool's cancel delay the holder may cancel alone with the
same receipt.

accounts.name: holder
docs: The pagaré's holder: the admin while the asset is in the pool.

instructions.name: revoke_procuracion
docs: Revokes the procuración in force on pagaré `draw_index` (LGTOC 41): appends the revocation
entry over the signed revocation's hash and takes the delegate back. The holder alone signs.

accounts.name: holder
docs: The pagaré's holder: the admin while the asset is in the pool. The owner alone revokes.

instructions.name: set_attestor
docs: Replaces the pool's attestor. The admin and the new attestor sign.

accounts.name: new_attestor
docs: The key that becomes the attestor; it signs, proving control of the key (C14).

instructions.name: set_cancel_delay
docs: Sets the backstop's wait, in seconds, from a cancellation request before the holder may
cancel a pagaré without the attestor; never below seven days. Admin only. A request fixes
its own deadline, so a change never moves one pending.

instructions.name: set_collection_period
docs: Sets the seconds a line in collection waits, from its mark, before it can be written off.
Admin only; refused below the 30-day floor.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Pauses or resumes deposits, redemptions, openings and draws. Repayments, collection and
write-offs are never paused.

instructions.name: suspend_draws
docs: Closes a line's draw window now. Admin only; refused unless the line is approved or
active. Repayment is untouched.

instructions.name: write_off
docs: Books the unpaid principal of a line as a loss. Admin only; refused before
`term_end + grace`, or on a line in collection before its oldest missed due date plus grace.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: Read for the share supply (`NavUpdated` and the invariant check).

accounts.name: vault
docs: Read for the NAV in the event.

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: The pool is paused

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Only the pool admin may do this

errors.name: WrongAmount
errors.msg: Amount is zero or exceeds what is due

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidity
errors.msg: Not enough liquidity in the vault

errors.name: LineStatus
errors.msg: The line is not in the required status

errors.name: TermNotEnded
errors.msg: The term has not ended

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: SponsorRequired
errors.msg: The sponsor named on this line must sign

errors.name: ZeroShares
errors.msg: The deposit would mint zero shares

errors.name: FirstDepositTooSmall
errors.msg: First deposit below the minimum

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: Wrong mint or token account

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: The result is below the minimum the caller accepts

errors.name: TermEnded
errors.msg: The term has ended, or would end before the opening

errors.name: InvalidSchedule
errors.msg: The installment schedule is not valid

errors.name: ScheduleEndsAfterTerm
errors.msg: The last installment would fall due after the term

errors.name: NotScheduled
errors.msg: The line has no installment schedule

errors.name: NotEnoughMissed
errors.msg: Fewer installments missed than the line allows before collection

errors.name: LateInterestUnpaid
errors.msg: The repayment must cover the late interest due

errors.name: WriteOffTooEarly
errors.msg: A line in collection is written off only after its oldest missed due date plus grace, or after the term plus grace

errors.name: BorrowerIsAdmin
errors.msg: The pool admin cannot be the borrower

errors.name: LineTooLarge
errors.msg: The principal exceeds the pool's maximum line, max_line_bps of the NAV

errors.name: InvariantBroken
errors.msg: A pool invariant does not hold after this instruction; the transaction is refused

errors.name: AssetMintNotAllowed
errors.msg: The asset mint carries a Token-2022 extension the pool does not accept

errors.name: ShareMintNotAllowed
errors.msg: The share mint is not one this pool can own and price: wrong authority, supply, decimals or extensions

errors.name: AttestorRequired
errors.msg: The pool's attestor must sign

errors.name: AvailabilityEnded
errors.msg: The draw window of this line has closed

errors.name: TooManyDraws
errors.msg: The line has reached its maximum number of draws

errors.name: CollectionNotAllowed
errors.msg: The collection is not a Metaplex Core collection whose update authority is the pool

errors.name: DocumentHashRequired
errors.msg: The signed pagaré's hash is required

errors.name: SignatureMethodInvalid
errors.msg: signature_method is unknown, or lacks its certificate fingerprint

errors.name: PagareNotCovered
errors.msg: The line has not repaid enough to cover this pagaré

errors.name: PagareAlreadyPaid
errors.msg: This pagaré is already marked paid

errors.name: NotHolder
errors.msg: The pagaré's holder must sign

errors.name: AttestorIsAdmin
errors.msg: The attestor cannot be the admin

errors.name: BorrowerIsAttestor
errors.msg: The borrower cannot be the attestor

errors.name: AgreementHashRequired
errors.msg: The signed agreement's hash is required

errors.name: ExpedienteRootRequired
errors.msg: The expediente root is required

errors.name: SponsorRoleInvalid
errors.msg: sponsor_role is unknown

errors.name: CollectionPeriodTooShort
errors.msg: The collection period is shorter than the minimum

errors.name: PagareAccountsMismatch
errors.msg: The sidecars passed are not the ones this payment touches, oldest first

errors.name: EndosoKindInvalid
errors.msg: This kind of endoso is not one the program records, or not in this version

errors.name: EndorseeInvalid
errors.msg: The endorsee is missing or is the pool itself

errors.name: ProcuracionState
errors.msg: The pagaré has no procuración in force, or already has one

errors.name: AnnotationKindInvalid
errors.msg: This kind is not a court annotation

errors.name: CancelDelayTooShort
errors.msg: The cancel delay is below the seven-day floor

errors.name: CancellationPending
errors.msg: A cancellation request is already pending on this pagaré

errors.name: EntryNotFound
errors.msg: The referenced registry entry does not exist

types.name: AttestorSet
docs: The pool's attestor, at `init_pool` and after every `set_attestor`.

types.name: CancelDelaySet
docs: The pool's cancel delay, at `init_pool` and after every `set_cancel_delay`: the backstop's wait
from a cancellation request before the holder may cancel alone.

types.name: CancellationRequested
docs: Emitted by `request_cancellation`, after its `PagareEntry`: the holder may cancel alone with
`receipt_hash` once `cancel_after` has passed.

types.name: CollectionPeriodSet
docs: The pool's collection period, at `init_pool` and after every `set_collection_period`: seconds
from the mark before a line in collection can be written off.

fields.name: sponsor
docs: A public program that co-signed the opening; `None` for a commercial line.

fields.name: agreement_hash
docs: Hash of the signed credit agreement.

fields.name: principal
docs: The approved commitment; `available = principal - drawn`.

fields.name: rate_bps
docs: Annual ordinary interest rate, in basis points, charged on each tranche from its draw to
the last due date.

fields.name: interest_due
docs: Ordinary interest charged so far: the sum over tranches of
`amount * rate_bps * (last_due - drawn) / (BPS * SECONDS_PER_YEAR)`, each fixed at its
draw. Zero at opening; it changes only at a draw.

fields.name: drawn_at
docs: Time of the first draw; informational (the calendar is `first_due_at`).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Zero on a bullet line (single maturity). On a scheduled line, the installment schedule,
read and written only through [`CreditLine::schedule`] and [`CreditLine::set_schedule`]:
| bytes  | field              | type    | meaning                                         |
| 0..8   | `interval_seconds` | i64 LE  | seconds between due dates                       |
| 8..10  | `installments`     | u16 LE  | number of installments, 1..=`MAX_INSTALLMENTS`  |
| 10..12 | `late_bps`         | u16 LE  | annual late interest rate on overdue amounts    |
| 12     | `max_missed`       | u8      | missed installments that allow collection       |
| 13     | `flags`            | u8      | reserved, zero                                  |
| 14..22 | `late_collected`   | u64 LE  | late interest collected so far                  |
| 22..30 | `late_paid_until`  | i64 LE  | late interest is settled up to this time        |
| 30..32 | unused             | zero    |                                                 |

fields.name: drawn
docs: Principal transferred to the borrower so far; `drawn <= principal`, never decreases.

fields.name: draws
docs: Number of tranches drawn; at most `MAX_DRAWS`.

fields.name: availability_end
docs: Last instant a draw is accepted (strict `<`): `first_due_at` on a scheduled line,
`term_end` on a bullet line, fixed at opening; `suspend_draws` brings it to now.

fields.name: first_due_at
docs: The first due date, from the signed contract; installment `k` is due at
`first_due_at + (k - 1) * interval`. Zero on a bullet line.

fields.name: sponsor_role
docs: `SPONSOR_PROMOTER` or `SPONSOR_GUARANTOR`; meaningful only when `sponsor` is named.

fields.name: expediente_root
docs: Salted merkle root of the credit file in the agreements engine. A commitment: no document,
name or folio is derivable from it.

fields.name: accelerated_at
docs: When `mark_in_collection` accelerated the balance (vencimiento anticipado); zero before.
From then on every installment is due and late interest runs on all remaining principal.
Also the start of the collection period: `write_off` waits
`Pool::collection_period_seconds` from it.

types.name: LateInterestCollected
docs: Late interest collected by a repayment of a scheduled line; it stays in the pool and raises
the NAV like interest. Emitted before the `LineRepaid` of the same repayment.

types.name: LineCancelled
docs: Emitted by `cancel_line`.

types.name: LineDrawState
docs: Emitted by `draw` after `LineDrawn`: the line after the tranche and the signed pagaré's hash,
which is not stored on the line.

types.name: LineDrawn
docs: One tranche; `amount` is the tranche, emitted once per draw.

types.name: LineDrawsSuspended
docs: Emitted by `suspend_draws`; `available_forfeited` is the undrawn remainder.

types.name: LineInCollection
docs: A scheduled line moved to collection and its balance accelerated. `remaining` is the principal
and interest still due after the acceleration, without late interest; `interest_forgiven` is
the ordinary interest of the installments not yet due at the mark, which the line no longer
owes (appended, events are append-only).

types.name: LineScheduled
docs: Emitted by `open_line` after `LineOpened` when the line has an installment schedule.

types.name: LineSponsorRole
docs: Emitted by `open_line` after `LineTermsSet`. `role` is `SPONSOR_PROMOTER` or
`SPONSOR_GUARANTOR`; `sponsor == None` and role 0 when no sponsor is named.

types.name: LineTermsSet
docs: Emitted by `open_line` after `LineOpened` (and `LineScheduled`). `first_due_at` is zero on a
bullet line.

types.name: NavUpdated
docs: The NAV and the share supply after every instruction that moves either (`deposit`, `redeem`,
`repay`, `write_off`), read back after the CPIs: `price per share = total_assets / share_supply`.

types.name: Pagare
docs: The program's record of one pagaré, the sidecar of the Core asset `draw` mints (C22). It holds
no folio and nothing personal, and is never closed: after `cancel_pagare` it stays as the
PAGADO mark.

fields.name: draw_index
docs: Which disposición of the line, 0-based: the `draws` count at the time of the draw.

fields.name: asset
docs: The Core asset at `[PAGARE_ASSET, line, draw_index]`.

fields.name: pagare_hash
docs: Hash of the signed pagaré data message, as `draw` received it.

fields.name: amount
docs: The tranche this pagaré documents.

fields.name: due_at
docs: The line's last due date at issuance: when the last payment is owed.

fields.name: drawn_through
docs: The line's `drawn` after this tranche: the sum of the amounts of pagarés 0..=draw_index.
The coverage rule reads it instead of summing earlier sidecars (pagarés are covered oldest
first): pagaré k is paid once the line's `principal_repaid` reaches `drawn_through`.

fields.name: cert_fingerprint
docs: Hash of the PSC certificate that signed the pagaré text (C6a); zero only when
`signature_method` is `SIGNATURE_WALLET`.

fields.name: signature_method
docs: `SIGNATURE_WALLET`, `SIGNATURE_PSC_WALLET` or `SIGNATURE_EFIRMA_WALLET`.

fields.name: status
docs: `PAGARE_OUTSTANDING` or `PAGARE_PAID`.

fields.name: paid_at
docs: When `cancel_pagare` marked it paid; zero while outstanding.

fields.name: receipt_hash
docs: Hash of the receipt the payment entry that marked it paid carried (LGTOC 129); zero while
outstanding.

fields.name: procurador
docs: The procurador of the endoso en procuración in force (`flags` bit 1); the zero key when
there is none. Set by `endorse_pagare`, cleared by `revoke_procuracion`.

fields.name: log_root
docs: The registry: `sha256(log_root || entry_hash)` over every entry, the issuance entry first.

fields.name: entry_count
docs: Entries in the chain; the issuance entry is 1.

fields.name: last_kind
docs: `KIND_*` of the last entry.

fields.name: flags
docs: `PAGARE_FLAG_*` bits.

fields.name: cancel_receipt_hash
docs: Hash of the final receipt `cancel_pagare` was given; zero until the burn.

fields.name: cancel_after
docs: When the holder requested a cancellation without the attestor (the backstop); zero otherwise.

fields.name: requested_receipt_hash
docs: The receipt hash of that request.

types.name: PagareCancelled
docs: Emitted by `cancel_pagare` (C22, LGTOC 129), before the burn. `holder` is the key that
extinguished the pagaré; the sidecar stays as the PAGADO mark. No AppData length: the engine
archives the log off chain before the burn.

fields.name: backstop
docs: The holder cancelled alone after a request's deadline, without the attestor.

types.name: PagareEntry
docs: One entry of a pagaré's registry (LGTOC 8 fr. VI, 13, 130): the full content the sidecar's
hash chain commits to. `stated_at` is the date the entry states (the signed message's date for
a late entry), `recorded_at` the slot's time.

types.name: PagareIssued
docs: Emitted by `draw` after `LineDrawState`: the pagaré issued as the Metaplex Core asset `asset`,
held frozen by `holder` (the pool PDA). `due_at` is the line's last due date at issuance.

types.name: PagarePayment
docs: The payment entries of one `repay` (art. 130): the payer's receipt hash (zero means "receipt
to follow"), the payment's split and one `PaymentEntry` per sidecar touched, oldest first.
Emitted after the `PagareEntry` of each entry.

types.name: PagareReceiptAnnotated
docs: A `Recibo` entry written by `annotate_payment`: the receipt attached to the payment entry
`payment_entry_count` of the pagaré's chain, as entry `entry_count`.

types.name: PaymentEntry
docs: One payment entry a `repay` wrote: the pagaré, the entry's kind (`Abono` or `Pagado`), its
position in that sidecar's chain, and the part of the payment's principal that fell on it.

fields.name: vault
docs: PDA token account `[VAULT, pool]` for `asset_mint`, owned by the pool PDA.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: The share token mint; its mint authority is the pool PDA.

fields.name: dead_shares
docs: PDA share token account `[DEAD, pool]`, owned by the pool PDA; never burned.

fields.name: outstanding_principal
docs: Principal drawn and neither repaid nor written off.

fields.name: interest_collected
docs: Informative running total.

fields.name: written_off
docs: Informative running total.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Pool parameters packed into spare bytes, so the account layout does not change:
| bytes   | field                  | type     | meaning                                   |
| 0..4    | `grace_period_seconds` | u32 LE   | grace after a due date; zero means none   |
| 4..6    | `max_line_bps`         | u16 LE   | largest line as a share of the NAV, in bps |
| 6       | `permissioned`         | u8 flag  | 1: shares are frozen by default (Token ACL) |
| 7       | `asset_controls`       | u8 bits  | bit 0: asset freeze authority; bit 1: Pausable |
| 8..12   | `cancel_delay_seconds` | u32 LE   | the backstop's wait from a cancellation request |
| 12..16  | `collection_period_seconds` | u32 LE | seconds from the mark before a write-off |
| 16..32  | unused                 | zero     |                                           |
Read and written only through the accessors below (`grace_period_seconds`,
`max_line_bps`, `permissioned`, `asset_controls`, `collection_period_seconds`,
`cancel_delay_seconds` and their setters).

fields.name: attestor
docs: The agreements engine's key; co-signs `open_line`, `draw` and `cancel_pagare`, attesting
the signed document behind the hash. Rotated with `set_attestor`; never the zero key.

fields.name: collection
docs: The series' Metaplex Core collection `draw` mints the pagaré assets into; validated at
`init_pool`.

types.name: PoolCollectionSet
docs: The series' Metaplex Core collection the pool records, at `init_pool`.

types.name: PoolConfigured
docs: Emitted by `init_pool` after `PoolInitialized`: the pool parameters fixed at launch.

types.name: PoolFlags
docs: Emitted by `init_pool` after `PoolLineCapSet`. `asset_controls` are the `Pool::asset_controls`
bits (bit 0 freeze authority, bit 1 Pausable); `permissioned`: the share mint is frozen by
default.

types.name: PoolLineCapSet
docs: Emitted by `init_pool` after `PoolConfigured`: the largest line as a share of the NAV, in bps.

types.name: ScheduleParams
docs: Installment terms requested by `open_line`; fixed for the life of the line.

fields.name: first_due_at
docs: The first due date (unix seconds), from the signed contract; must be after the opening.

fields.name: interval_seconds
docs: Seconds between due dates; installment `k` is due at `first_due_at + (k - 1) * interval_seconds`.

fields.name: installments
docs: `drawn + interest_due` is paid in this many installments.

fields.name: late_bps
docs: Annual late interest rate on overdue amounts, in basis points.

fields.name: max_missed
docs: Missed installments after which anyone may move the line to collection.
